name: we_work_remotely-deals-mcp
description: We Work Remotely (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The feed answers its whole current list in one response (all current remote jobs, RSS 2.0, ~80 items and ~800 KB); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). These are employment listings: title is '<company>: <job title>'; region, country, skills (comma-separated text), category, type and expires_at stay in raw; description is HTML. Per-category feeds (/categories/<slug>.rss) exist but are not selectable here.
